name: Evening Star
description: A three-candle bearish reversal pattern that forms at the top of an uptrend. Candle 1 is a large bullish candle, candle 2 is a small-bodied indecision candle (star) that gaps up, and candle 3 is a large bearish candle that closes well into candle 1's body. Represents the transition from bullish control to bearish control.

body_rules.candle_1: large bullish (green/white) body indicating strong buying momentum
body_rules.candle_2: small real body of either color (doji or spinning top); opens above candle 1 close; the gap up is ideal but not mandatory in forex/crypto
body_rules.candle_3: large bearish (red/black) body that closes at least 50% into candle 1's body; opens below candle 2 body

wick_rules.candle_1_wicks: not critical; long upper wick on candle 1 is acceptable
wick_rules.candle_2_wicks: can have wicks in either direction; doji version is the strongest signal
wick_rules.candle_3_wicks: small lower wick preferred; long upper wick on candle 3 reduces conviction

context_requirement: must form at the end of an uptrend at a key resistance level, Fibonacci extension level, or supply zone; pattern appearing mid-range is not valid
volume_requirement: candle 1 may have high volume; candle 2 should have lower volume signaling exhaustion; candle 3 should have the highest volume of the three confirming bearish commitment
agent_rules: Confirm the pattern is at a resistance zone, Fibonacci level (161.8% extension or prior highs), or supply zone
Enter short after candle 3 closes or at the open of candle 4
Stop loss above the high of candle 2 (the star) or above the pattern high
The deeper candle 3 closes into candle 1's body, the stronger the reversal signal
A doji for candle 2 is the strongest star variation
Candle 3 volume should be visibly higher than candles 1 and 2
Do not trade this pattern if candle 3 fails to close at least halfway into candle 1's body
